note: vespera_macro round-33 fixes: #[route] error_status accepts only 400-599 (success, informational and redirect codes are a compile error); a set-but-empty VESPERA_DOCS_URL / VESPERA_REDOC_URL / VESPERA_SPEC_URL counts as unset; an undecided cfg_attr(p, cron(..)) job is registered under #[cfg(p)] so rustc decides as it does for the attribute; a (None, name) route storage entry is used only for the sole route of its name; a multi-line string containing [workspace] no longer marks a workspace root; the parallel OpenAPI workers capture the call-site module before the fallback is forced, and their errors are rebuilt after the guard drops; the landing version sync refuses symlinks and paths that leave the checkout; the version-PR CI dispatch runs in its own step so the write token is never in the tree-running step's env; native-image JDK 17 toolchain detection and bench-interleaved partial samples are fixed; the cron fold of an escaping .. is documented.
